test_title: PYST 117: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is brother of B’

If D + E + F – G × H ÷ I – J, then which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: E is the daughter of G

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

Statement given : D + E + F – G × H ÷ I – J

So,

 
• D + E → D is the daughter of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dd7111e155bce4d6efe8cef6bfc36ef0e84806897fb0dd32a2a73897a74f32b.png] 

 
• E + F → E is the daughter of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79cffb8ab319df62f18358d60616ec526aedd541598f18ff8776113c9f63eba7.png] 

 
• F – G → F is the husband of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a7ee14e3c5d1406f339a8dcbdb2850a9e78f9356c2bed37c1d7439f01ff2513.png] 

 
• G × H → G is the mother of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f5afa2c813df5d75b0c892a71eab882539308d1861957d554d85a84befc594f.png] 

 
• H ÷ I → H is the brother of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8cf2d33974d1ccb877bfca41b341b9b309e0f1a921ba47401fd95eff8573180.png] 

 
• I – J → I is the husband of J.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ae684de31507561be6188044b8292afd580d59c022c1b57d865baaac332c41f.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree :

 
• Option - (1) : D is sister of I → **Incorrect statement** ⇒ D is niece of I
 
• Option - (2) : E is sister of I → Correct statement
 
• Option - (3) : E is sister of H → Correct statement
 
• Option - (4) : E is the daughter of G → Correct statement

Hence, "**Option - (1)**" is the correct answer.
